Boss: can't be insta-killed – an insta-kill face hits it for %d with a crit instead.
Defence %d / %d: each segment soaks a point of damage before the ice shield and health; armour piercing attacks bypass it. One segment recovers at the end of every round.
Ice shield %d / %d: damage hits the shield first and the rest carries over to health; armour piercing attacks take double from it. Recovers %d in any round it takes no damage.
Move %d: tiles it can move each turn; difficult terrain costs more.
Defence 0: takes the full damage of every hit.
On fire: takes %d damage at the start of the next round.
Poisonous hits: a hit that damages you poisons you – 1 damage at the start of each of your turns until a heal cures it.
Range %d%s: attacks from up to %d tiles away with line of sight.
Stunning hits: a hit that damages you stuns you – you can't act until the next round (in its turn: you lose your next turn).
Strikes first: when you attack it, it hits you before your attack lands.
Poisoned: it takes 1 damage at the start of every enemy turn until it dies.
Stunned: it can't act until the next round – no first strike, retaliation, move or attack.
Fiery hits: a hit that damages you sets you on fire – half that damage again (rounded down) at the start of your next turn.
Freezing hits: a hit that damages you freezes you – your movement is halved (rounded up) on your next turn. Teleporting is not affected.
Burning: you take half the damage of the hit that set you on fire (rounded down) at the start of your next turn, then the flames go out.
Frozen: your movement is halved (rounded up) for your next turn. Teleporting is not affected.
Poisoned: you take 1 damage at the start of each of your turns. The next heal cures it instead of restoring health.
Stunned: you can't act until the next round. Stunned during your turn, the rest of your plan is skipped; stunned in the enemy turn, you lose your next turn – no roll, straight to the enemy turn.
Attack %d: deals %d damage, less the target's defence. Combine attack dice for one bigger hit.
Buff: +1 to every other rolled %s die this turn (no die goes above %d). Used automatically.
Critical: doubles the highest die in the attack – this one or another die combined with it.
Defence %d: blocks %d damage from a hit. Kept all turn and spent when you're hit.
Dodge: avoids one whole hit. Kept all turn and spent when you're hit.
Insta-kill: kills any normal enemy outright. A boss takes %d damage with a crit instead.
Move %d: move up to %d tiles; difficult terrain costs more. Combine move dice to go further.
Pierce %d: ignores %d of the target's defence, and deals double damage to an ice shield.
Poison: the target takes 1 damage at the start of each enemy turn until it dies.
Range +%d: this attack reaches %d tiles further. Combined with a die without range, the range is lost.
Stun: the target can't act until the next round – no first strike, retaliation, move or attack.
Teleport: blink to any free tile in range and line of sight, ignoring terrain. Lost if combined with normal move dice.
